target: versioned formula analysis workspace with calculation traceability

contract.purpose: Turn one submitted manufacturing formula into a traceable composition report with visible assumptions and corrections.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Formula Composition Engine helps food, nutraceutical, supplement, and medicinal-product formulation teams turn one mixed-format batch formula into a reviewable macro, micro, active, preservative, and uncertainty report by combining exact unit-safe calculation with ranked, correctable ingredient identities.
contract.audience: Formulators and product teams reviewing food, nutraceutical, supplement, or medicinal batch formulas.
contract.job: Submit one formula, correct only material ambiguities, and export a traceable composition report.
contract.thesis: The formula is the work surface; uncertainty belongs visibly at the edge of each result rather than in a separate compliance dashboard.
contract.system: Clear Compliance Desk: one restrained professional workspace with a single pasted-table input and inline corrections.
contract.signature: Every uncertain value carries a visible evidence band linked to the ingredient assumption that created it.
contract.risk: A visually expressive evidence system could distract from high-density review; the selected direction must preserve familiar table scanning and keyboard correction.

findings: The selected-direction composite is retained as the visual baseline because no dedicated pre-increment screenshot existed.
